scope: tape20 only; active city backlink blogs; missing evidence is not proof a crop is absent
key_lookup: For roya: source- plus first 16 hex characters of sha256(queue item key). Other blogs: exact queue item key. Refer to data/<blog>/backlink-queue.json.
published_action: Research before any live edit; no published history changed.
unpublished_action: Regenerate or approve municipal crop evidence before publication.
